rust_summary: maps a server mod draws, kept by the world: `native_new_map` and `native_paint_map`.
doc_summary: `native_new_map(dimension, colors)` makes a locked map of the world showing a 128 x 128 picture, under the world's next map id, saved with its maps and sent like any map to whoever carries it or sees it framed (Bukkit's `Server.createMap`); `native_paint_map(map_id, colors)` replaces a map's whole picture the same way (`MapCanvas`). Bundles need "hooks": @API:new_map@.
